question: How does the autonomous consciousness regulate itself across all beings?
premises: The principle 'let it see' expresses the regulation of the autonomous.
This regulation, called together with the senses, pervades from Shiva down to the worm.
Throughout this range it rests upon its own consciousness.
inference: The same autonomous self-awareness regulates and pervades all levels of existence from highest to lowest.
plain_english: The regulation of the autonomous, expressed as 'let it see' and called together with the senses, is that very consciousness which, ascending from Shiva down to the worm, rests upon its own awareness.
